clauses.reason: This clause adds to section 1 of Executive Order No. 11861 the entry (15) Deputy Under Secretary for Congressional and Public Affairs, Department of Agriculture. Later event: Executive Order 11983, signed 1977-05-04, section 1(c) states "By revising subsection (15)" to read (15) Director, Office of Congressional and Public Affairs, Department of Agriculture; text before: Deputy Under Secretary for Congressional and Public Affairs; text after: Director, Office of Congressional and Public Affairs. The substance changed in that the title of the position changed; the clause continues, amended. Terminated by Executive Order 12076, signed 1978-08-18, whose section 1-202 states "Executive Order No. 11861, as amended, is hereby revoked." No delay of that revocation appears in its held text, so the date is the signing date.

research_rationale:
Identity: the held Federal Register text of Executive Order 11898, signed January 14, 1976, amends section 1 of Executive Order No. 11861, as amended, which places positions in level IV, by adding as item (15) Deputy Under Secretary for Congressional and Public Affairs, Department of Agriculture. I read the whole order, a single paragraph; the representation is the machine-extracted text layer of the official PDF and page images were not inspected. End: Executive Order 12076, signed August 18, 1978 (43 FR 37161, issue of August 22, 1978), revokes the parent order as amended and re-places the position as Director, Office of Congressional and Public Affairs, Department of Agriculture in its own level IV list. Later event: Executive Order 11983 (signed May 4, 1977; 42 FR 23127) revised item (15) to read Director, Office of Congressional and Public Affairs, Department of Agriculture; under the owner ruling on strike-and-insert amendments the clause continues, amended, until the parent ends. Executive Order 12076 does not name this order; the end is recorded because it revokes the parent this order amends (owner rulings on unnamed instruments and strike-and-insert).

savings.reason: Executive Order 12076 section 1-201 preserves the appointment of any occupant of a position listed in its section 1-1 who held it immediately before that order, and its section 1-101 lists the Director, Office of Congressional and Public Affairs, Department of Agriculture among level IV positions. Placement continues under Executive Order 12076 and the occupant's appointment is not terminated.
